blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books; word forms checked with the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я пыталась преодолеть ___ застенчивость, но безуспешно.
exercises.why: **свою** agrees with **застенчивость** (feminine singular). «The word "свой" is declined like "мой".» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: I have tried to overcome my shyness, but to no avail.

exercises.q: Только я собирался выразить ___ мнение, как встрял он.
exercises.why: **своё** agrees with **мнение** (neuter singular). «The word "свой" is declined like "мой".» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: I was just going to express an opinion, when he cut in.

exercises.q: Том, не дашь мне ___ домашку по математике перекатать?
exercises.why: **свою** agrees with **домашку** (feminine singular). «The word "свой" is declined like "мой".» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Tom, will you let me copy your math homework?

exercises.q: Я купил ___ дедушке на восьмидесятивосьмилетие шарф.
exercises.why: **своему** agrees with **дедушке** (masculine singular). «The word "свой" is declined like "мой".» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: I bought a scarf for my grandfather for his 88th birthday.

exercises.q: Том подошёл слишком близко к огню и подпалил ___ бороду.
exercises.why: **свою** agrees with **бороду** (feminine singular). «The word "свой" is declined like "мой".» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Tom got too close to the fire and singed his beard.

exercises.q: В имитации дети предпочитают родителям ___ сверстников.
exercises.why: **своих** agrees with **сверстников** (plural). «The word "свой" is declined like "мой".» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Children imitate their peers rather than their parents.

exercises.q: Мэри хочет покрасить ___ машину в ярко-голубой цвет.
exercises.why: **свою** agrees with **машину** (feminine singular). «The word "свой" is declined like "мой".» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Mary wants to paint her car bright blue.

exercises.q: Дизайнер расхваливает ___ проект, но мне он не нравится.
exercises.why: **свой** — the object belongs to the performer of the action ("his own"): "свой" must be used, not "его". «If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: The designer praises his own project, but I don't like it.

exercises.q: Его никто не любит, потому что он всегда дудит в ___ дуду.
exercises.why: **свою** — the object belongs to the performer of the action ("his own"): "свой" must be used, not "его". «If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Nobody likes him, because he is always blowing his own horn.

exercises.q: Том раздражается, ведь он всегда должен выбирать ___ путь.
exercises.why: **свой** — the object belongs to the performer of the action ("his own"): "свой" must be used, not "его". «If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Tom is irritating because he always has to have his own way.

exercises.q: Том выпекает ___ хлеб с помощью хлебопечки.
exercises.why: **свой** — the object belongs to the performer of the action ("his own"): "свой" must be used, not "его". «If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Tom bakes his own bread with a bread machine.

exercises.why: **своему** — the object belongs to the performer of the action ("his own"): "свой" must be used, not "его". «If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: God created man in his own image.

exercises.why: **свою** — the object belongs to the performer of the action ("his own"): "свой" must be used, not "его". «If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: Tom faked his own death again.

exercises.why: **своей** — the object belongs to the performer of the action ("his own"): "свой" must be used, not "его". «If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
exercises.prompt: He became an exile in his own country.
